Title: 80 Million Americans Have Thinning Hair - Here's What Actually Speeds It Up

Description:
80 million Americans have thinning hair, and genetics isn't the whole story. Sudden shifts in diet and supplements can push hair follicles into shedding mode faster.

Sugary drinks, crash diets, and vitamin megadoses are three things doctors say can speed it up - and yes, even the hair vitamins people take to fix this can backfire.

Watch to find out why, and simple swaps that help.
